product_goal: A model that chooses attacks and switches in varied full-team battles and later proves advantage on natural battles

mission_check.reusable_capability: Authenticated TRAIN trainer battles with model-controlled attacks and switches, complete choice/outcome logs, and read-only admission of executed short-horizon alternatives
mission_check.learned_authority: No new trained authority yet; the frozen move head and fixed switch rule remain a baseline
mission_check.transfer_test: Untouched natural DEVELOPMENT battles against frozen and fixed controls remain unopened
mission_check.cheapest_falsifier: A distinct TRAIN trainer battle exposes an invalid cartridge outcome or a matched choice set fails exact action/resource admission
mission_check.stop_condition: No replay of failed attempts, no weakened PP/HP guard, no fit or DEVELOPMENT access before independent review

retained_failed_variants.cause: Off-slot PP increase at decision 12 still not established; the old in-flight after-state was not retained

retained_failed_variants.configuration: custom-stat Gastly against Articuno and Dragonite, caused by mistaken internal-versus-National species identifiers
retained_failed_variants.invalid_last_completed_decision: Actor HP became 65535 after a knockout, above its declared maximum of 90; the next feature projection rejected it
retained_failed_variants.mechanism: Custom level-30 HP 90 exceeded cartridge-neutral HP 58; a level-up stat recalculation is a plausible mechanism, not established from the retained after-state

safety_improvements.outcome_admission: Future trainer episodes reject party or active HP above maximum before projecting and logging a selected-turn outcome
safety_improvements.resource_telemetry: Each future decision records party maximum HP and levels plus active maximum HP and level
safety_improvements.species_identity: An optional expected National Dex number for each combatant is checked against the authenticated cartridge before teacher writes; Red internal species IDs remain the executable references
safety_improvements.matched_choice_admission: An authenticated TRAIN capture must bind every branch, first executed action, equal turn horizon, plausible resources, zero intervention and explicit terminal. It reports measured metrics, not a teacher-preferred or unplayed-action target

new_valid_train_configuration.actor: Pikachu, National Dex 25, neutral cartridge-derived stats, level 32
new_valid_train_configuration.interpretation: A useful observed TRAIN attack-versus-switch contrast; no scalar fit target was created

verification.broader_suite: interrupted after 1676 passes and three collection-registry failures caused by running with newly edited executable source before regeneration/commit; not a full-suite pass

review_questions: Does fail-closed handling and explicit exclusion of the two failed variants suffice before fitting, despite the original PP mechanism remaining unknown?
Does the measured six-choice two-turn contrast support a title-neutral attack-versus-switch target without target leakage or counting siblings as independent roots?
What minimum distinct TRAIN roots and opponent/role coverage should be required before a switch-aware fit and untouched natural DEVELOPMENT comparison?
next_gate: Astra reviews this frozen pretraining boundary. Training remains gated on the review's accepted admission, target and diversity requirements; no DEVELOPMENT battle or full run is authorized here.
